name: Sacubitril/valsartan
route_note: oral tablet twice daily; sprinkle pellets for children

discovery.note: A supramolecular sodium salt complex of sacubitril and valsartan in a 1:1 molar ratio.

tagline: First angiotensin receptor–neprilysin inhibitor, reshaping heart failure care
summary: Sacubitril/valsartan combines a neprilysin inhibitor prodrug with an angiotensin II receptor blocker. In the PARADIGM-HF trial it reduced cardiovascular death and heart failure hospitalisation compared with enalapril, and it is a cornerstone therapy for heart failure with reduced ejection fraction.
mechanism: Sacubitril is converted to LBQ657, which inhibits neprilysin, the enzyme that degrades natriuretic peptides, bradykinin and other vasoactive peptides. Higher natriuretic peptide levels promote vasodilation, natriuresis and reduced cardiac remodelling.

Neprilysin also breaks down angiotensin II, so neprilysin inhibition alone would raise it; valsartan blocks the AT1 receptor to counter this. Combining neprilysin inhibition with an ACE inhibitor causes excessive angioedema, so the two must not be used together.
uses: Chronic heart failure in adults, to reduce cardiovascular death and hospitalisation (benefit most evident with LVEF below normal)
Symptomatic heart failure with systemic left ventricular dysfunction in children ≥1 year

history.title: PARADIGM-HF
history.detail: The trial is stopped early after showing a 20% reduction in cardiovascular death or HF hospitalisation versus enalapril.

history.title: Approvals
history.detail: Approved in the US (July) and EU (November).

history.title: PARAGON-HF
history.detail: In heart failure with preserved ejection fraction, the primary endpoint narrowly misses significance.

history.title: Paediatric approval
history.detail: FDA approves use in children with heart failure.

history.title: Expanded indication
history.detail: FDA broadens the label to adults with chronic heart failure, with greatest benefit below normal LVEF.

history.title: Medicare negotiation
history.detail: Entresto is among the first ten drugs selected for US Medicare price negotiation.

history.title: US generics
history.detail: Generic sacubitril/valsartan launches in the US after patent litigation.

pk.half_life: Sacubitril ~1.4 h; LBQ657 ~11.5 h; valsartan ~9.9 h
pk.bioavailability: Sacubitril ≥60%; valsartan in this formulation more bioavailable than standalone
pk.metabolism: Sacubitril hydrolysed by esterases to LBQ657; valsartan minimally metabolised
pk.excretion: LBQ657 mainly renal; valsartan mainly biliary

safety.boxed_warning: Fetal toxicity: drugs acting on the renin-angiotensin system can cause injury and death to the developing fetus; discontinue when pregnancy is detected.

facts: A 36-hour washout is required when switching from an ACE inhibitor.
Natriuretic peptide BNP rises on treatment, while NT-proBNP is not a neprilysin substrate and remains interpretable.

references.title: McMurray JJV et al. Angiotensin–neprilysin inhibition versus enalapril in heart failure (PARADIGM-HF). N Engl J Med 2014
